dog.description_text:
My #BoroughBreak Buddy Writes: Vanner might be the sweetest, most gentle dog I've ever met! She loves pets and also has a sense of curiosity for the world - being equally down for an outdoor adventure or indoor relaxation. Vanner walks very well and expressed gentle interest in meeting new people and dogs, especially if they pet her. Vanner is food motivated, knows 'sit' and 'down' and is ready to keep learning! On our walk back, we ran into several ACC staff members that all excitedly greeted Vanner - it's clear she is universally adored! One can immediately tell Vanner is ready for a home where she will be showered in affection, and will readily return love with her gentle kindness.

Meet Vanner!
Some friendships take a little time, and Vanner is hoping to find someone who understands that! Found as a stray, this sweet, sensitive girl is still getting used to meeting new people. A little coaxing and some tasty treats can help bring her out of her shell, and she's happy to follow along once she feels comfortable. Vanner is looking for a patient person who will help her discover that the world can be a pretty wonderful place!

My Ideal Home
Vanner would love a quiet, cozy home with someone who understands that trust is built one little step at a time. A predictable routine, fun enrichment activities, and plenty of positive encouragement will help her settle in. Food puzzles, long lasting chews, and sniffing adventures are great ways to keep her busy while she gets comfortable in her new surroundings.

Good with Other Pets?
Vanner came to us as a stray, so her history with other pets is unknown. Any introductions to potential furry friends should be slow and thoughtful, giving everyone plenty of time to feel comfortable.

Good with Kids?
Vanner would do best in an adult only home. She's a sensitive girl who needs a little extra time and space to warm up, so a quieter environment with patient grown ups will help her feel right at home.

Things to Know
Vanner can be a little unsure about being touched or having her collar handled, so it's important to let her approach on her own terms. Tasty treats and gentle encouragement are wonderful ways to build a friendship. She also pulls moderately on leash and will benefit from some practice walking comfortably alongside her person. With patience and kindness, this sweet girl is sure to find her confidence!
dog.name: Vanner
